name: fecfile-mcp
description: Search FEC committees, retrieve campaign finance filings, and analyze them server-side
long_description: An MCP server providing all FEC network access for campaign finance analysis: committee and filing search against the authenticated FEC API, plus filing retrieval and server-side analysis (top items, group totals) from the public filing archive. The API key is optional — it is needed only for committee/filing search, is configured during installation, and is stored securely in your system keychain/credential manager. Filing retrieval and analysis by filing ID need no key.

tools.name: search_committees
tools.description: Search for FEC committees by name. Returns committee IDs that can be used with get_filings. Requires the FEC API key.

tools.name: get_filings
tools.description: Get FEC filings for a committee. Returns filing IDs, dates, and financial summaries. Filter by cycle, form type, or report type. Requires the FEC API key.

tools.name: fetch_filing
tools.description: Fetch one filing's summary or a page of schedule itemizations from the public filing archive. No API key needed.

tools.name: analyze_filing
tools.description: Stream a whole filing schedule server-side and return the N largest items or totals grouped by a field. No API key needed.

fec_api_key.title: FEC API Key
fec_api_key.description: Your API key from api.open.fec.gov/developers. Optional — needed only for committee/filing search; filing analysis by filing ID works without it.
